title: Odisha Teachers' Dance Reel Wins Hearts
summary: A group of Odisha teachers created a popular dance reel called 'Muqabla' that has won the hearts of many people. The video, which features the teachers dancing to a Bollywood song, has been viewed millions of times on social media platforms. The success of the video has also led to it being shared widely across various online platforms.
summary_points: A group of Odisha teachers created a popular dance reel called 'Muqabla'.
The video features the teachers dancing to a Bollywood song and has been viewed millions of times on social media.
The success of the video has led to it being shared widely across various online platforms.
The video's popularity has also sparked interest in the creators' work.
The 'Muqabla' dance reel is an example of how social media can help launch careers or create viral sensations.
title_hi: ओडिशा शिक्षकों के दांतकथा वीडियो दिलों में बस गए
summary_hi: ओडिशा शिक्षकों ने एक लोकप्रिय दांतकथा वीडियो बनाया, जिसने कई लोगों के दिलों में बस गया। यह वीडियो, जिसमें शिक्षकों ने बॉलीवुड गीत पर नृत्य किया है, सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म्स पर मिलियन्स ऑफ़ व्यूज़ देखे गए।
summary_points_hi: ओडिशा शिक्षकों ने एक लोकप्रिय दांतकथा वीडियो बनाया।
वीडियो में शिक्षकों का नृत्य बॉलीवुड गीत पर है, और इसे सोशल मीडिया पर मिलियन्स ऑफ़ व्यूज़ देखा गया।
वीडियो की सफलता ने इसके बनाने वालों के काम में रुचि जगाई।
दांतकथा वीडियो एक उदाहरण है कि सोशल मीडिया कैसे करियर को लॉन्च कर सकता है या वायरल होने की ओर ले जा सकता है।

framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on the 'internet can't stop watching' phrase from India Today's headline, emphasizing the video's popularity and the internet's role in spreading it widely. They also highlight the creator's identity as a woman, which is mentioned in the article.
